task: Survey task. Find every NON-TEST call site in cli-go of `pathsafe.ValidateProjectSlug` and every non-test call site of `WilsonLower`, and report each by file path and the enclosing function or line number. Then state which of the two functions has its definition in a different package than its callers. Do not include _test.go files. If a symbol has no callers outside its own file, say so. This is a read-only task: do not edit, write, or create any file.

criteria.name: recall-of-callsites
criteria.anchor: 1.0: every non-test call site of both symbols is named by file and enclosing function or line. 0.5: most are named. 0.0: few or none.

expected_outcomes: Lists every non-test call site of ValidateProjectSlug: the call sites are in the grpcserver, serve and supervise packages (three sites at authoring time)
Lists the WilsonLower definition and its non-test call sites, all in cli-go/internal/routing/routing.go and none outside that file
States ValidateProjectSlug is defined in internal/pathsafe (a different package from its callers) and WilsonLower's callers share a file with its definition
Reports each location by file plus enclosing function or a line number that matches the file at eval time (verify with grep); invents no locations
